audit_kind: independent CSV-only numerical recomputation; no model import, forward pass, or training

statistics.units: CSV accuracy fractions; multiply deltas and SD by 100 for percentage points

method: Read only the seven CSV files listed under inputs into byte snapshots; verify unchanged bytes before writing this new audit record.
Index the 42 unique selected rows by target/background/paired-block/condition. Verify the exact two-target, three-block, shared-A plus three-background B/C design and selected_primary flags.

For each target/background/condition, obtain exactly three distinct paired-block values from unique selected rows; use shared A by key. Recompute mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum for six metrics: test accuracy, test answer CE, dev accuracy, dev CE, train accuracy, and majority accuracy.
Recompute all 54 per-block B-A, C-A, B-C test/dev differences directly from unique raw rows; then verify 18 summaries including n, mean, sample SD, extrema and negative/zero/positive block counts.

Recompute all 18 per-block background differences of B-C for g1-g0, g2-g0 and g2-g1 using paired blocks; verify test/dev deltas, component test contrasts and sign reversals. Verify all six interaction summaries and reversal counts.
Verify the 54-row display table preserves every raw field, repeats each shared A exactly three times, and each B/C once; display rows are never the source of pooled SD or sample count.

Use only Python standard-library csv, math, statistics, hashlib, datetime and pathlib; no summarize.py or experiment engine is imported. All numerical comparisons use absolute tolerance 1e-14 and zero relative tolerance.
scope_note: This numerical audit is independent of checkpoint/data/chronology checks in FINAL_AUDIT.json. Three paired blocks jointly vary inputs, initialization and optimization randomness; shared backgrounds and targets are not independent replications.
